description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It handles configuration and display logic for generating various test documentation reports, including test specifications, requirements, test plans, and execution reports. The script initializes page settings, processes user input, manages tree views for navigation, and sets report options.

classes.name: printDocOptions
classes.description: A class providing configuration and preferences for generating printed documents, including methods to retrieve print preferences and document options.

methods.name: getJSPrintPreferences
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code or data for print preferences configuration.

methods.name: getReqSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns options specific for requirement specifications.

methods.name: getTestSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns options specific for test specifications.

methods.name: getExecOpt
methods.description: Returns options related to execution reports.
